documents.title: Hornady sitemap (used to enumerate bullet product pages)
Hornady - A-Tip, ELD Match, ELD-X and ELD-VT Ballistic Coefficient Values
19 Hornady bullet product pages (one per record; see record sources)

meta.notes: Values come from the inline "var item = {...}" object that each www.hornady.com product page embeds in its own HTML to render its specification table; evidence holds the verbatim raw "key":value text of that object plus the visible "Item # | /Box" line. bcG1/bcG7 are the product-page BCs (ball_coef_1 typed "(G1)", ball_coef_2_f typed "(G7)"). For ELD Match, ELD-X, A-Tip Match and ELD-VT, Hornady states its published BCs are Mach 2.25 (2512 fps, ICAO) values; Mach 2.25/2.0/1.75 values from https://www.hornady.com/bc are in bcNotes/bcMach. Hornady does not publish bullet length, boat-tail length or base-to-ogive on these pages, so those are null. construction/tip are set only when the page wording supports them (quoted in notes); otherwise null. profile = profile abbreviations printed in the product name, verbatim. The 2027 product catalog PDF (static.hornady.media) was not reachable (proxy-blocked host). sectionalDensity and boxCount are extra fields taken from the same page.
